snippet.title: HFI Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
High Fantasy Idle is an idle RPG with unique class-based gameplay and an expanding narrative. Play a variety of character classes and level them up while assigning perks and buying items, then rebirth them to find newfound power. Embark on a journey of fantasy and mystery to unravel your destiny!

Demo available here: https://saizonic.itch.io/hfi
WISHLIST HFI here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459200/High_Fantasy_Idle/
